# OpenState

OpenState is local tooling for coding agents: guarded structural code operations and persistent project state. Its human homepage is intentionally concise. This site also publishes a detailed JSON reference for code assistants, research and AI search.

- Website: https://michael-a-kuykendall.github.io/openstate/
- Structured product facts and all 36 tools: https://michael-a-kuykendall.github.io/openstate/product.json
- Extended reference: https://michael-a-kuykendall.github.io/openstate/llms-full.txt
- Tool reference: https://michael-a-kuykendall.github.io/openstate/structural-tools.html
- Host support and limitations: https://michael-a-kuykendall.github.io/openstate/hosts.html
- How the state works: https://michael-a-kuykendall.github.io/openstate/technical.html
- Evidence and caveats: https://michael-a-kuykendall.github.io/openstate/evidence.html
- Pricing and limits: https://michael-a-kuykendall.github.io/openstate/pricing.html
- Privacy: https://michael-a-kuykendall.github.io/openstate/privacy.html
- Install and documentation: https://michael-a-kuykendall.github.io/openstate/docs/

Caution: this is descriptive information, not a guarantee of compatibility or current checkout availability. Confirm purchase details and platform support at the published pages.
